info.title: IYA STS remote PEP AuthZEN edge PDP
info.description: AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0's access evaluation, evaluations and metadata, answered by a remote PEP from the policy and attribute catalogue it pulled from its realm, so that a PEP nearby can ask a PDP nearby. A caller is admitted by a client certificate (mutual TLS) on the HTTPS listener it connected to, which must ask for one and verify it (PEP_AUTHZEN_CLIENT_CA or its trust anchors, and its tuning asking), verified against PEP_AUTHZEN_CLIENT_CA and named on the caller list the PEP pulls from the service (GET /xacml/pep/authzen-callers), optionally narrowed by PEP_AUTHZEN_CALLERS. The metadata admits anybody. The Search APIs and the Access Request profile are 403 without admission: the service holds the directory and the approval store. A switched-off API is 403 too, and the metadata names only the endpoints that answer: AuthZEN 1.0 prescribes no status for an API a PDP does not serve or has switched off (its section 10.1.2 defines 400, 401, 403 and 500), only that an endpoint absent from the metadata is one the PDP is not capable of (section 9.1.1). Every answer is application/json with Cache-Control: no-store; a POST's answer echoes a valid X-Request-ID. EVERY PEP FAILURE IS A 403, never a 5xx: nothing pulled yet, an engine fault, a binding tuple the edge cannot decide, a forward the service did not answer or answered with anything but a decision, 400 or 413. Error codes are recorded in the PEP's log and never sent. Paths not listed are 404 with the PEP's NotFound body.

servers.description: The HTTPS listener, PEP_HTTPS_PORT, or an HTTPS listener of purpose api the service defines.

mutualTLS.description: A client certificate verified against PEP_AUTHZEN_CLIENT_CA whose SHA-256 is on a pulled caller's certificates, the caller's endpoints naming this endpoint. Refusals: 401 the listener the request arrived on asks for no certificate it can verify (STS-XPEP-0039; on plain HTTP, the environment's HTTPS listener is asked), none presented or plain HTTP (0035), did not verify (0036), the realm's caller door is not mtls (0052); 403 not on the pulled list (0051), endpoint not admitted (0053), not on PEP_AUTHZEN_CALLERS (0054, or 0037 before the first pull); 403 no list pulled and none configured (0050, a PEP failure). No challenge header is sent.

Properties.description: Members the realm's attribute catalogue declares, a dotted path of at most six segments nested as objects; a value is a scalar of the row's datatype, or for a bag row an array of at most 256. An undeclared member is 400 STS-AUTHZEN-0004, a null 0005, a wrong type or form 0006, a wrong multiplicity 0007, a wrong nesting 0008.

Approval.description: Unknown members are ignored. id is required when the object is present.

supported_obligations.description: Each item at most 64 characters. Present, including an empty array, is supplied and not mapped.

Context.description: application names the application asked about, one of the caller's; required when the caller is scoped to more than one (400 STS-AUTHZEN-0027), refused when not one of them (403 STS-AUTHZEN-0025). supported_obligations and approval are reserved and are not catalogue properties: a bad shape is 400 STS-AUTHZEN-0003. An approval is recognized and not used (STS-AUTHZEN-0084); the answer's context then says reason approval_unverifiable and next_action none. Every other member is a catalogue property, as in Properties.

EvaluationRequest.description: Members other than these four are ignored. Refusals are 400: not an object STS-AUTHZEN-0001, a missing entity or member 0002, a wrong type 0003, and the catalogue's 0004 to 0008.

EvaluationItem.description: One evaluation: each entity it carries replaces the default whole.

EvaluationsRequest.description: The defaults, merged into each item; with no items, the defaults are one evaluation answered as the single endpoint answers. More than the realm's authzen.maxEvaluations items is 400 STS-AUTHZEN-0038; a body over authzen.maxBodyBytes 400 STS-AUTHZEN-0037; an unknown semantic 0036.

ObligationProperties.description: The obligation's properties: a registered type's, or xacml_obligation for custom. A value is the assignment's lexical form, a string; an array member is an array even of one.

undischargeable_obligations.description: Obligation ids that made a Permit false (STS-AUTHZEN-0029).

obligations.description: Handed when the PEP declared every type and the realm's obligations profile is on. A Permit is then true.

reason.description: When the request presented context.approval: approval_unverifiable, since this edge verifies no approval (STS-AUTHZEN-0084), as the service answers an approval it cannot verify.

next_action.description: With reason: none, since this edge serves no access-request endpoint.

DecisionContext.description: Decided here: present when the realm's authzen.returnReasons is on, holding xacml_decision and reason_admin, and undischargeable_obligations and advice when not empty; and whenever obligations were handed, whether or not reasons are on. Forwarded to the service (an application enforcing fine-grained authorization): the service's context, whole, whatever returnReasons says. On a batch item that failed: error alone.

decision.description: True only on a Permit with nothing undischargeable, or a Permit whose obligations were handed because the caller declared every type; decided deny-biased. A failed batch item is false with context.error, including a token-exchange tuple (403, STS-XPEP-0140).

EvaluationsResponse.description: In request order; under deny_on_first_deny or permit_on_first_permit it ends at the item that stopped it.

policy_decision_point.description: The identifier in force (the managed authzenPdpIdentifier, else PEP_AUTHZEN_PDP_IDENTIFIER), else https://<authority> of an HTTPS request: its Host header, or over HTTP/2 the :authority it sent.

access_evaluations_endpoint.description: Only while the realm's authzen.batchEnabled is on.

supported_obligations.description: step-up, notification, session_termination, then custom. Only while the realm's authzen.obligationsProfile is on. No signed_metadata, access_request_endpoint, jwks_uri or capabilities member is published.

post.description: Decided here against the pulled root policy, deny-biased, the PIP consulted when subject.type is one of the realm's resolveSubjectTypes; or, for an application that enforces fine-grained authorization, forwarded to the service's POST /access/v1/evaluation with context.application set, and its answer passed through. While the realm's authzen.tokenExchange is on, a token-exchange binding tuple (every gate and scope tuple, and a declared detail type beside a token-exchange gate) is 403 (STS-XPEP-0140, a PEP failure) before it is read or forwarded; off, it is an ordinary evaluation. Either way a context member the binding reads, on a tuple that is not the binding's, is 400 STS-AUTHZEN-0101. Content-Type must be application/json after admission (415 STS-AUTHZEN-0117).

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Echoed on the answer when it matches the pattern; else neither echoed nor forwarded.

400.description: The request's shape or the catalogue refused it (STS-AUTHZEN-0001 to 0008), a context member the token-exchange binding reads on a tuple that is not the binding's (0101), it names no application among several (0027), or the service answered 400 to a forward (STS-XPEP-0057).

403.description: Admission, or an application the caller is not scoped to (STS-AUTHZEN-0025) or no application at all (0026). Or a PEP failure: nothing pulled yet, the policies and catalogue (STS-XPEP-0043) or the callers (0050); the engine could not evaluate it (STS-AUTHZEN-0028); a token-exchange binding tuple (STS-XPEP-0140); a forward the service did not answer or answered too late (PEP_AUTHZEN_FORWARD_TIMEOUT_MS, 0055), refused this PEP (0056), answered a 5xx or another status (0057) or no decision (0058). Or the API not served or switched off (501 before #2208; AuthZEN 1.0 prescribes no status for it): Turned off here (PEP_AUTHZEN, STS-XPEP-0044) or in the realm (STS-AUTHZEN-0013, 0014).

413.description: Larger than PEP_MAX_BODY_BYTES (STS-XPEP-0046), or the service's 413 to a forward (0057).

post.description: Each item merged over the defaults and decided as the single endpoint decides one, a failed item answered false with context.error rather than failing the batch. With no items the defaults are one evaluation, answered as EvaluationResponse with the single endpoint's statuses. Turned off by the realm's authzen.batchEnabled (501 STS-AUTHZEN-0039, before admission).

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Echoed when valid; item i is logged and forwarded as <id>#<i>.

200.description: The decisions; or, with no items, one decision.

400.description: Not an object (STS-AUTHZEN-0001), evaluations or options of the wrong type (0003), an unknown semantic (0036), too large (0037), too many items (0038); with no items, the single endpoint's 400s.

403.description: Admission, or nothing pulled yet (STS-XPEP-0043, 0050: a PEP failure); with no items, the single endpoint's 403s. Or the API not served or switched off (501 before #2208; AuthZEN 1.0 prescribes no status for it): Turned off here (STS-XPEP-0044), in the realm (STS-AUTHZEN-0013, 0014), or the batch off (0039).

get.description: No admission. Reads the Host header, or the request's authority when it has none (an HTTP/2 client's :authority), to name the identifier when no identifier is set. supported_obligations is published while the realm's obligations profile is on. No search, access-request, key, capability or signed_metadata member is published. HEAD is answered as GET without the body.

403.description: A PEP failure: the policies and catalogue not yet pulled (STS-XPEP-0043). Or the API not served or switched off (501 before #2208; AuthZEN 1.0 prescribes no status for it): Turned off here (STS-XPEP-0044) or in the realm (STS-AUTHZEN-0013, 0014).

404.description: No identifier: none is set and the request was not HTTPS with a usable Host or authority (STS-XPEP-0045); or the CRL-only listener (0114, NotFound body).

post.description: 403 STS-XPEP-0138. This edge does not hold the directory or the catalogues. Not advertised in the metadata. HEAD is 404.
